expertiseSources.summary: Records the immutable upstream commit, operational lessons, portability changes, overlap boundaries, and security review for the migrated worktree orchestration workflow.
Distinguishes historical identities from runtime worker capabilities and defines privacy-preserving, bounded trace analysis.

exception.rationale: The workflow reduces checkout collisions, overlapping agent writes, accidental changes to live worktrees, and unvalidated multi-branch integration. The revision preserves ownership when a historical worker handle is unavailable and refuses blind messages or replacement writers. These risk controls require behavioral and maintainer review rather than a claimed average efficiency uplift.
